subhero.en: Stelara, Skyrizi, and Entyvio are three of the most commonly prescribed biologic drugs for moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease in the United States, and their 2026 price tags differ enormously. Stelara carries a Medicare-negotiated Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day-supply equivalent under the Inflation Reduction Act, effective January 1, 2026, and now faces competition from at least six FDA-approved biosimilars. Skyrizi has no negotiated Medicare price and no generic competitor, so a single dose can run $13,000 to $33,000 without insurance. Entyvio sits in between at $3,500 to $10,100 per dose and was just selected for Medicare's third round of price negotiation, with a negotiated price arriving in 2028. This guide breaks down cash prices, Medicare Part B and Part D rules, manufacturer patient assistance programs, and the biosimilar landscape for all three drugs side by side.
subhero.es: Stelara, Skyrizi y Entyvio son tres de los medicamentos biologicos mas recetados para la enfermedad de Crohn moderada a grave en Estados Unidos, y sus precios en 2026 difieren enormemente. Stelara tiene un Precio Maximo Justo negociado por Medicare de $4,695 por suministro equivalente de 30 dias bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026, y ahora enfrenta competencia de al menos seis biosimilares aprobados por la FDA. Skyrizi no tiene precio negociado por Medicare ni competidor generico, por lo que una sola dosis puede costar $13,000 a $33,000 sin seguro. Entyvio se ubica en un punto intermedio, entre $3,500 y $10,100 por dosis, y fue seleccionado para la tercera ronda de negociacion de precios de Medicare, con un precio negociado que llegara en 2028.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, cash prices without insurance range from about $3,500 per dose for the Entyvio subcutaneous pen to as much as $33,000 per dose for the Skyrizi Crohn's maintenance regimen, with Stelara falling between $11,000 and $17,000 per injection. Medicare Part D enrollees on Stelara pay the IRA-negotiated Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day-supply equivalent starting January 1, 2026; Skyrizi and Entyvio have no negotiated Medicare price yet, though Entyvio was selected for Round 3 negotiation with a price effective 2028. Stelara has at least six FDA-approved biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Yesintek, Otulfi, and Steqeyma) priced 80 to 90 percent below the brand, while Skyrizi and Entyvio have no generic or biosimilar competition as of 2026. Each manufacturer runs a separate income-based patient assistance program: Janssen CarePath for Stelara, myAbbVie Assist for Skyrizi, and Takeda Help at Hand for Entyvio, all offering free drug to uninsured patients near or above 500 percent of the federal poverty level.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los precios en efectivo sin seguro van desde aproximadamente $3,500 por dosis para el bolígrafo subcutaneo de Entyvio hasta $33,000 por dosis para el regimen de mantenimiento de Skyrizi para Crohn, con Stelara entre $11,000 y $17,000 por inyeccion. Los inscritos en Medicare Parte D con Stelara pagan el Precio Maximo Justo negociado por la IRA de $4,695 por suministro equivalente de 30 dias a partir del 1 de enero de 2026; Skyrizi y Entyvio no tienen precio negociado por Medicare aun, aunque Entyvio fue seleccionado para la negociacion de la Ronda 3 con un precio efectivo en 2028. Stelara tiene al menos seis biosimilares aprobados por la FDA, mientras que Skyrizi y Entyvio no tienen competencia generica ni biosimilar en 2026. Cada fabricante opera un programa de asistencia al paciente separado basado en ingresos.

callout.en: Stelara was one of the first 10 drugs selected for Medicare price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. Starting January 1, 2026, Medicare beneficiaries pay a Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 for a 30-day-supply equivalent of Stelara, down from a 2023 list price of $13,836, a 66 percent reduction. CMS has confirmed Stelara will exit the negotiated-drug list on January 1, 2027 because biosimilar competition from Wezlana, Selarsdi, and five other approved biosimilars now drives the price down independently. Skyrizi has never been selected for IRA negotiation through Round 3 and carries no Maximum Fair Price as of 2026. Entyvio was selected for Round 3 negotiation, announced in January 2026, with a Maximum Fair Price scheduled to take effect January 1, 2028, not yet published.
callout.es: Stelara fue uno de los primeros 10 medicamentos seleccionados para la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022. A partir del 1 de enero de 2026, los beneficiarios de Medicare pagan un Precio Maximo Justo de $4,695 por un suministro equivalente de 30 dias de Stelara, una reduccion del 66% desde el precio de lista de 2023 de $13,836. CMS ha confirmado que Stelara saldra de la lista negociada el 1 de enero de 2027 porque la competencia de biosimilares de Wezlana, Selarsdi y otros cinco biosimilares aprobados ya reduce el precio de forma independiente. Skyrizi nunca ha sido seleccionado para la negociacion IRA a traves de la Ronda 3 y no tiene Precio Maximo Justo en 2026. Entyvio fue seleccionado para la negociacion de la Ronda 3, anunciada en enero de 2026, con un Precio Maximo Justo que entrara en vigor el 1 de enero de 2028.

introParagraphs.en: Stelara (ustekinumab), Skyrizi (risankizumab), and Entyvio (vedolizumab) are three biologic drugs approved by the FDA to treat moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease when older therapies, including corticosteroids and TNF inhibitors, have not worked well enough. Stelara blocks interleukin-12 and interleukin-23, Skyrizi blocks only interleukin-23, and Entyvio blocks a gut-specific integrin called alpha-4-beta-7 rather than targeting interleukins at all. That mechanism difference matters clinically, but for a patient comparing 2026 prices, the bigger differences are generic and biosimilar status, Medicare price-negotiation status, and which manufacturer runs the patient assistance program. For single-drug detail beyond Crohn's disease, see the dedicated pages for [Stelara cost](/en/drug/stelara-cost) and [Skyrizi cost](/en/drug/skyrizi-cost), which cover psoriasis and psoriatic-arthritis dosing separately from the higher Crohn's induction and maintenance doses covered here.
introParagraphs.es: Stelara (ustekinumab), Skyrizi (risankizumab) y Entyvio (vedolizumab) son tres medicamentos biologicos aprobados por la FDA para tratar la enfermedad de Crohn moderada a grave cuando terapias mas antiguas, incluyendo corticosteroides e inhibidores del TNF, no han funcionado lo suficiente. Stelara bloquea la interleucina-12 y la interleucina-23, Skyrizi bloquea solo la interleucina-23, y Entyvio bloquea una integrina especifica del intestino llamada alfa-4-beta-7 en lugar de dirigirse a las interleucinas. Esa diferencia de mecanismo importa clinicamente, pero para un paciente que compara precios de 2026, las diferencias mas grandes son el estado generico y biosimilar, el estado de negociacion de precios de Medicare, y que fabricante opera el programa de asistencia al paciente.

introParagraphs.en: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, signed August 16, 2022, gave CMS the authority to negotiate Medicare drug prices directly with manufacturers for the first time. Stelara was one of the first 10 drugs selected, and its Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day-supply equivalent took effect January 1, 2026, a 66 percent cut from the pre-negotiation list price. Skyrizi has never appeared on any negotiation round through Round 3, so Medicare pays whatever standard formulary rate applies, with no statutory ceiling. Entyvio was selected for Round 3 in January 2026, one of the first Part B-administered infused biologics to be chosen, and its negotiated price will not take effect until January 1, 2028. Patients should not expect an Entyvio price cut before then.
introParagraphs.es: La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022, otorgo a CMS la autoridad para negociar directamente los precios de medicamentos de Medicare con los fabricantes por primera vez. Stelara fue uno de los primeros 10 medicamentos seleccionados, y su Precio Maximo Justo de $4,695 por suministro equivalente de 30 dias entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2026, una reduccion del 66% desde el precio de lista previo a la negociacion. Skyrizi nunca ha aparecido en ninguna ronda de negociacion a traves de la Ronda 3. Entyvio fue seleccionado para la Ronda 3 en enero de 2026, uno de los primeros biologicos infundidos de la Parte B en ser elegido, y su precio negociado no entrara en vigor hasta el 1 de enero de 2028.

introParagraphs.en: Payers routinely require step therapy for Crohn's disease biologics, meaning your plan may insist you try a cheaper option, often an adalimumab biosimilar (Humira's generic-equivalent class) or infliximab, before approving Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio. Prior authorization is standard for all three drugs regardless of which one your gastroenterologist prescribes first. The formulary tier a plan assigns to each drug also drives your copay: Stelara now sits on many formularies alongside its biosimilars, while Skyrizi and Entyvio remain sole-source brands with no lower-tier alternative in their own molecule class. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare treatment, generic or biosimilar status, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all three drugs together.
introParagraphs.es: Los pagadores exigen rutinariamente terapia escalonada para los biologicos de la enfermedad de Crohn, lo que significa que su plan puede insistir en que pruebe una opcion mas economica, a menudo un biosimilar de adalimumab o infliximab, antes de aprobar Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio. La autorizacion previa es estandar para los tres medicamentos sin importar cual le receta primero su gastroenterologo. El nivel de formulario que un plan asigna a cada medicamento tambien determina su copago: Stelara ahora se encuentra en muchos formularios junto a sus biosimilares, mientras que Skyrizi y Entyvio siguen siendo marcas de fuente unica sin alternativa de nivel mas bajo en su propia clase molecular.

paragraphs.en: Hospital outpatient infusion centers routinely bill Entyvio's IV formulation, and occasionally Skyrizi's or Stelara's IV induction dose, at two to four times the rate a freestanding infusion center or physician office charges for the identical drug and dose. The markup covers facility overhead, nursing time, and chair-time fees that a hospital adds on top of the drug's acquisition cost. A single Entyvio infusion that costs roughly $9,900 to $10,100 at a physician office can appear on a hospital outpatient bill at $20,000 or more once facility fees are layered in.
paragraphs.es: Los centros de infusion ambulatorios hospitalarios facturan rutinariamente la formulacion IV de Entyvio, y ocasionalmente la dosis de induccion IV de Skyrizi o Stelara, a dos a cuatro veces la tarifa que cobra un centro de infusion independiente o un consultorio medico por el mismo medicamento y dosis. El recargo cubre gastos generales de instalacion, tiempo de enfermeria y tarifas de tiempo de silla que un hospital agrega sobre el costo de adquisicion del medicamento.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part A stops paying for any of these three biologics the moment a patient is discharged from an inpatient stay; coverage shifts to Part B for physician-administered doses or Part D for self-injected doses at home. That transition is where Stelara's 2026 Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 kicks in for patients switching from inpatient care to outpatient maintenance, while Skyrizi and Entyvio patients face standard, uncapped formulary cost-sharing. Anyone discharged on a new Crohn's biologic prescription without active Part D or Part B coverage should call 1-800-MEDICARE before the first outpatient dose to confirm which benefit applies.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte A deja de pagar cualquiera de estos tres biologicos en el momento en que un paciente es dado de alta de una estancia hospitalaria; la cobertura pasa a la Parte B para dosis administradas por un medico o a la Parte D para dosis autoinyectadas en casa. Esa transicion es donde entra en vigor el Precio Maximo Justo de Stelara de $4,695 para pacientes que pasan de atencion hospitalaria a mantenimiento ambulatorio, mientras que los pacientes de Skyrizi y Entyvio enfrentan un costo compartido de formulario estandar y sin limite.

paragraphs.en: Site-of-care matters as much as the drug choice itself for all three biologics. Choosing a freestanding infusion center or your gastroenterologist's own infusion suite over a hospital outpatient department can cut the facility portion of an Entyvio, Skyrizi, or Stelara bill substantially without changing the drug at all. Ask your gastroenterology practice directly whether they offer in-office infusion or injection administration before your first dose is scheduled at a hospital.
paragraphs.es: El lugar de atencion importa tanto como la eleccion del medicamento para los tres biologicos. Elegir un centro de infusion independiente o la propia sala de infusion de su gastroenterologo en lugar de un departamento ambulatorio hospitalario puede reducir sustancialmente la porcion de instalacion de una factura de Entyvio, Skyrizi o Stelara sin cambiar el medicamento en absoluto.

intro.en: Medicare and most commercial plans bill the IV and physician-administered formulations of these three drugs using HCPCS Level II J-codes. Each code represents a 1 mg unit, so the number of units billed should match your prescribed dose in milligrams.
intro.es: Medicare y la mayoria de los planes comerciales facturan las formulaciones IV y administradas por medico de estos tres medicamentos usando codigos HCPCS Nivel II. Cada codigo representa una unidad de 1 mg, por lo que el numero de unidades facturadas debe coincidir con su dosis prescrita en miligramos.

intro.en: Janssen (a Johnson & Johnson company), AbbVie, and Takeda each run a separate income-based patient assistance program for their Crohn's biologic, and eligibility thresholds differ across the three. If you have no insurance and a household income near or above 500 percent of the federal poverty level, your drug may still cost $0 through the correct manufacturer program, but you must apply to the specific company that makes your prescribed drug.
intro.es: Janssen (una empresa de Johnson & Johnson), AbbVie y Takeda operan cada uno un programa de asistencia al paciente separado basado en ingresos para su biologico de Crohn, y los umbrales de elegibilidad difieren entre los tres. Si no tiene seguro y un ingreso familiar cercano o superior al 500% del nivel federal de pobreza, su medicamento aun puede costar $0 a traves del programa correcto del fabricante.

Section 1320a-7b). If you have any government insurance, use the manufacturer's income-based patient assistance program instead of a savings card, or apply for Medicare Part D Extra Help through Social Security at 1-800-772-1213.

Seccion 1320a-7b). Si tiene cualquier seguro del gobierno, use el programa de asistencia al paciente basado en ingresos del fabricante en lugar de una tarjeta de ahorro.

paragraphs.en: Medicare treats these three Crohn's biologics differently depending on where the drug is given. IV induction doses administered in a physician office or hospital outpatient department fall under Part B, with 20 percent coinsurance after the 2026 Part B deductible of $283, except for Stelara's IV induction dose, which also carries the negotiated Maximum Fair Price. Self-injected SC maintenance doses given at home fall under Part D, landing on the specialty tier of your plan's formulary. All out-of-pocket Part D spending across every drug you take, not just your Crohn's biologic, counts toward the same 2026 annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100.
paragraphs.es: Medicare trata a estos tres biologicos de Crohn de manera diferente segun donde se administre el medicamento. Las dosis de induccion IV administradas en un consultorio medico o departamento ambulatorio hospitalario caen bajo la Parte B, con 20% de coseguro tras el deducible de Parte B de 2026 de $283, excepto la dosis de induccion IV de Stelara, que tambien tiene el Precio Maximo Justo negociado. Las dosis de mantenimiento SC autoinyectadas en casa caen bajo la Parte D, en el nivel especializado del formulario de su plan.

paragraphs.en: Extra Help, the Part D Low Income Subsidy, reduces cost-sharing further for Medicare beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay $12.65 per fill for a brand-name specialty drug like Skyrizi or Entyvio, and typically less for Stelara or one of its biosimilars once the plan's specialty-tier structure applies. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150 percent of the federal poverty level. Apply through the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or at ssa.gov before applying to any manufacturer patient assistance program, since several manufacturer programs require proof that you applied for or were denied Extra Help first.
paragraphs.es: Extra Help, el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D, reduce aun mas el costo compartido para beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. En 2026, los inscritos en Extra Help pagan $12.65 por reposicion para un medicamento especializado de marca como Skyrizi o Entyvio, y generalmente menos para Stelara o uno de sus biosimilares. Extra Help generalmente esta disponible para beneficiarios con ingresos al o por debajo del 150% del nivel federal de pobreza.

intro.en: Crohn's biologics generate some of the most complex bills in outpatient medicine because a single treatment course mixes Part B infusion charges, Part D specialty-pharmacy fills, and manufacturer copay-card adjustments. Watch for these issues before paying any bill for Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio:
intro.es: Los biologicos para Crohn generan algunas de las facturas mas complejas en medicina ambulatoria porque un solo curso de tratamiento mezcla cargos de infusion de Parte B, reposiciones de farmacia especializada de Parte D y ajustes de tarjeta de copago del fabricante. Verifique estos problemas antes de pagar cualquier factura por Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio:

items.en: Pharmacy or infusion center bills more than Stelara's $4,695 IRA Maximum Fair Price for a Medicare Part D fill in 2026, which violates federal law; ask your plan's member services to reprocess the claim.
items.es: La farmacia o centro de infusion factura mas del Precio Maximo Justo IRA de Stelara de $4,695 para una reposicion de Medicare Parte D en 2026, lo que viola la ley federal; pida a servicios de miembros de su plan que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: A biosimilar (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Yesintek, Otulfi, or Steqeyma) billed at the Stelara brand price instead of the lower biosimilar rate.
items.es: Un biosimilar facturado al precio de marca de Stelara en lugar de la tarifa biosimilar mas baja.

items.en: Manufacturer copay card applied for a patient who has Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits, which is prohibited and can trigger a claim clawback months later.
items.es: Tarjeta de copago del fabricante aplicada a un paciente que tiene beneficios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA, lo cual esta prohibido y puede desencadenar una recuperacion del reclamo meses despues.

items.en: Wrong J-code units billed, for example 600 units of J2327 (Skyrizi) charged when only a partial vial was actually administered, inflating the coinsurance owed.
items.es: Unidades de codigo J incorrectas facturadas, por ejemplo 600 unidades de J2327 (Skyrizi) cobradas cuando solo se administro un vial parcial, inflando el coseguro adeudado.

items.en: Hospital outpatient department charging 2 to 4 times the freestanding infusion-center rate for an identical Entyvio or Skyrizi IV dose without disclosing the facility fee separately.
items.es: Departamento ambulatorio hospitalario cobrando 2 a 4 veces la tarifa de un centro de infusion independiente por una dosis IV identica de Entyvio o Skyrizi sin revelar el cargo de instalacion por separado.

items.en: Step-therapy denial requiring a trial of a cheaper biologic without documenting that the required first-step drug already failed or is medically contraindicated for you.
items.es: Denegacion de terapia escalonada que requiere una prueba de un biologico mas economico sin documentar que el medicamento de primer paso requerido ya fallo o esta medicamente contraindicado.

note.en: The three drugs compared here have three very different biosimilar outcomes in 2026. Stelara (ustekinumab) has at least six FDA-approved biosimilars on the US market since 2023, priced 80 to 90 percent below the brand, making it by far the cheapest of the three once a biosimilar is substituted. Skyrizi (risankizumab) has no generic or biosimilar competition as of 2026; its patents are expected to protect the brand until approximately 2033, since risankizumab was not first approved until 2019. Entyvio (vedolizumab) also has no FDA-approved biosimilar as of 2026, though several biosimilar candidates are in late-stage clinical trials; its patent protection is expected to run until approximately 2029. None of the three is available as a small-molecule generic because all three are biologics, so cost reduction depends on biosimilar substitution (Stelara only, for now), IRA negotiation (Stelara now, Entyvio starting 2028), or a manufacturer patient assistance program.
note.es: Los tres medicamentos comparados aqui tienen tres resultados biosimilares muy diferentes en 2026. Stelara (ustekinumab) tiene al menos seis biosimilares aprobados por la FDA en el mercado de EE.UU. desde 2023, con precios 80 a 90% por debajo de la marca, lo que lo convierte por mucho en el mas economico de los tres una vez que se sustituye un biosimilar. Skyrizi (risankizumab) no tiene competencia generica ni biosimilar en 2026; se espera que sus patentes protejan la marca hasta aproximadamente 2033. Entyvio (vedolizumab) tampoco tiene biosimilar aprobado por la FDA en 2026, aunque varios candidatos biosimilares estan en ensayos clinicos de fase tardia; se espera que su proteccion de patente dure hasta aproximadamente 2029. Ninguno de los tres esta disponible como generico de molecula pequena porque los tres son biologicos.

Skyrizi's myAbbVie Assist uses a higher, approximately 600% FPL threshold; multiply the 100% FPL base ($15,960 for household size 1 in 2026) by 6 to find that threshold.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Part D plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan Parte D. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a letter from your gastroenterologist documenting Crohn's disease severity, prior treatment failures, and why Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio specifically is medically necessary.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta de su gastroenterologo que documente la gravedad de la enfermedad de Crohn y los fallos de tratamiento previos.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your gastroenterologist to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, documenting why a cheaper step-therapy drug already failed, caused adverse effects, or is contraindicated given your specific history.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su gastroenterologo que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan, documentando por que un medicamento de terapia escalonada mas economico ya fallo, causo efectos adversos o esta contraindicado.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part D or Part B plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Your state's Medicaid income limits page can also point you to state-specific fair-hearing rights if you have Medicaid.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes Medicare Parte D o Parte B al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado para planes comerciales.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy, typically a trial of an adalimumab biosimilar or infliximab before approving Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio, your gastroenterologist can file a step-therapy exception documenting that the required first-step drug is medically contraindicated, was already tried and failed to control your Crohn's disease, or that delaying the requested biologic would cause serious harm given active disease flare or complications. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada, generalmente una prueba de un biosimilar de adalimumab o infliximab antes de aprobar Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio, su gastroenterologo puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando que el medicamento de primer paso requerido esta medicamente contraindicado, ya se probo y fallo, o que retrasar el biologico solicitado causaria dano grave.

papFallback.en: If all insurance appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug: Johnson & Johnson Patient Assistance Foundation (jjpaf.org) for Stelara, myAbbVie Assist (abbvie.com) for Skyrizi, or Takeda Help at Hand (helpathandpap.com) for Entyvio. Each has a different FPL threshold, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones de seguro fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico: la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Johnson & Johnson (jjpaf.org) para Stelara, myAbbVie Assist (abbvie.com) para Skyrizi, o Takeda Help at Hand (helpathandpap.com) para Entyvio.

genericAlternative.en: Stelara has a true lower-cost alternative: any of six FDA-approved biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Yesintek, Otulfi, or Steqeyma) at 80 to 90 percent below the brand price, with no clinically meaningful difference from the reference product. Skyrizi and Entyvio have no biosimilar alternative as of 2026; patients who cannot afford either should discuss switching to a biosimilar-available drug class, such as an adalimumab or infliximab biosimilar, with their gastroenterologist rather than delaying treatment.
genericAlternative.es: Stelara tiene una verdadera alternativa de menor costo: cualquiera de los seis biosimilares aprobados por la FDA a 80 a 90% por debajo del precio de marca, sin diferencia clinicamente significativa del producto de referencia. Skyrizi y Entyvio no tienen alternativa biosimilar en 2026; los pacientes que no puedan pagar ninguno deben discutir el cambio a una clase de medicamento con biosimilar disponible, como un biosimilar de adalimumab o infliximab, con su gastroenterologo.

If you have Medicare, apply for Part D Extra Help first at 1-800-772-1213, since some manufacturer programs require proof of that application.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Llame al 1-800-652-6227 o visite jjpaf.org (para Stelara), abbvie.com/patients/patient-support/patient-assistance.html (para Skyrizi), o helpathandpap.com (para Entyvio) para confirmar la elegibilidad de su medicamento especifico.

Complete the patient section (name, address, household income, household size, insurance status) and have your gastroenterologist complete and sign the prescriber section with a medical necessity attestation.

Enrollment is generally valid for 12 months; annual re-enrollment requires resubmitting income documentation.

en.question: Is there a generic or biosimilar for Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio?
en.answer: Yes for one of the three. Stelara (ustekinumab) has at least six FDA-approved biosimilars as of 2026: Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Yesintek, Otulfi, and Steqeyma, priced 80 to 90 percent below the brand. Skyrizi (risankizumab) has no generic or biosimilar; patent protection is expected until approximately 2033. Entyvio (vedolizumab) also has no approved biosimilar as of 2026, though candidates are in late-stage trials; its patent runs to approximately 2029.

en.question: How do I apply for the Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio patient assistance program?
en.answer: Apply to the manufacturer of your specific drug: the Johnson & Johnson Patient Assistance Foundation at jjpaf.org for Stelara, myAbbVie Assist at abbvie.com for Skyrizi, or Takeda Help at Hand at helpathandpap.com for Entyvio. Each requires proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation of no prescription drug coverage. Processing takes 7 to 15 business days, and approved patients typically get a 12-month supply requiring annual re-enrollment.

en.question: Can I use a Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio manufacturer savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay savings card, including Stelara withMe, SKYRIZI Complete, and EntyvioConnect. Medicare Part D patients on Stelara should instead rely on the 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $4,695; Skyrizi and Entyvio patients should apply for Part D Extra Help or the matching manufacturer patient assistance program.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for my Crohn's biologic or requires step therapy?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a letter from your gastroenterologist documenting medical necessity. If your plan requires step therapy with a cheaper biologic first, your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception documenting contraindication, prior failure, or urgent risk from an active Crohn's flare. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug as a fallback.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price apply to Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio?
en.answer: It applies to one of the three so far. Stelara was selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act negotiation, with a Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day-supply equivalent, effective January 1, 2026. Skyrizi has never been selected through Round 3. Entyvio was selected for Round 3 negotiation, announced January 2026, but its Maximum Fair Price will not take effect until January 1, 2028.

en.question: What does each Crohn's biologic cost without insurance at the pharmacy or infusion center in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, Entyvio runs $3,500 to $10,100 per dose depending on formulation, Stelara runs $11,000 to $17,000 per injection, and Skyrizi runs $13,000 to $33,000 per dose for Crohn's-specific dosing. A GoodRx coupon can drop Stelara's cash price to roughly $7,000 to $7,300 per syringe, but Skyrizi and Entyvio have little coupon discount available since they track manufacturer list price closely.

en.question: Do I qualify for a Crohn's biologic patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: It depends on which drug you take, since each manufacturer sets a different income cutoff. Janssen CarePath and the Johnson & Johnson Patient Assistance Foundation for Stelara generally require household income at or below approximately 500 percent of the Federal Poverty Level ($79,800 for one person in 2026). Takeda Help at Hand for Entyvio uses the same roughly 500 percent FPL threshold. myAbbVie Assist for Skyrizi is more generous, at roughly 600 percent FPL.

en.question: Which is cheapest for Crohn's disease: Stelara, Skyrizi, or Entyvio?
en.answer: For uninsured patients without a manufacturer PAP, Entyvio is typically the cheapest per dose at $3,500 to $10,100, though it requires more frequent dosing than Stelara. If you can access a Stelara biosimilar (Wezlana, Selarsdi, or another), that becomes the cheapest option overall at 80 to 90 percent below brand pricing. Skyrizi is consistently the most expensive of the three because it has no negotiated Medicare price and no generic or biosimilar competition as of 2026.

es.question: ¿Hay un generico o biosimilar para Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio?
es.answer: Si para uno de los tres. Stelara (ustekinumab) tiene al menos seis biosimilares aprobados por la FDA en 2026: Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Yesintek, Otulfi y Steqeyma, con precios 80 a 90% por debajo de la marca. Skyrizi (risankizumab) no tiene generico ni biosimilar; se espera proteccion de patente hasta aproximadamente 2033. Entyvio (vedolizumab) tampoco tiene biosimilar aprobado en 2026, aunque hay candidatos en ensayos de fase tardia; su patente dura hasta aproximadamente 2029.

es.question: ¿Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente de Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio?
es.answer: Solicite al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Johnson & Johnson en jjpaf.org para Stelara, myAbbVie Assist en abbvie.com para Skyrizi, o Takeda Help at Hand en helpathandpap.com para Entyvio. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene cobertura de medicamentos con receta.

es.question: ¿Puedo usar una tarjeta de ahorro del fabricante de Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de copago del fabricante, incluyendo Stelara withMe, SKYRIZI Complete y EntyvioConnect. Los pacientes de Medicare Parte D con Stelara deben confiar en el Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2026 de $4,695; los pacientes de Skyrizi y Entyvio deben solicitar Extra Help de Parte D o el programa de asistencia del fabricante correspondiente.

es.question: ¿Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de mi biologico para Crohn o requiere terapia escalonada?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta de su gastroenterologo que documente la necesidad medica. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada con un biologico mas economico primero, su prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion documentando contraindicacion o fallo previo. Si la apelacion falla, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico.

es.question: ¿Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio?
es.answer: Aplica a uno de los tres hasta ahora. Stelara fue seleccionado para la primera ronda de negociacion de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con un Precio Maximo Justo de $4,695 por suministro equivalente de 30 dias, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026. Skyrizi nunca ha sido seleccionado a traves de la Ronda 3. Entyvio fue seleccionado para la negociacion de la Ronda 3, anunciada en enero de 2026, pero su Precio Maximo Justo no entrara en vigor hasta el 1 de enero de 2028.

es.question: ¿Cuanto cuesta cada biologico para Crohn sin seguro en la farmacia o centro de infusion en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, Entyvio cuesta $3,500 a $10,100 por dosis segun la formulacion, Stelara cuesta $11,000 a $17,000 por inyeccion, y Skyrizi cuesta $13,000 a $33,000 por dosis para la dosificacion especifica de Crohn. Un cupon de GoodRx puede bajar el precio en efectivo de Stelara a aproximadamente $7,000 a $7,300 por jeringa.

es.question: ¿Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente para biologicos de Crohn segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Depende de que medicamento tome, ya que cada fabricante establece un limite de ingresos diferente. Janssen CarePath y la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Johnson & Johnson para Stelara generalmente requieren ingresos del hogar al o por debajo de aproximadamente 500% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($79,800 para una persona en 2026). Takeda Help at Hand para Entyvio usa el mismo umbral aproximado de 500% FPL. myAbbVie Assist para Skyrizi es mas generoso, con aproximadamente 600% FPL.

es.question: ¿Cual es mas barato para Crohn: Stelara, Skyrizi o Entyvio?
es.answer: Para pacientes sin seguro y sin un PAP del fabricante, Entyvio suele ser el mas barato por dosis a $3,500 a $10,100, aunque requiere dosificacion mas frecuente que Stelara. Si puede acceder a un biosimilar de Stelara, esa se convierte en la opcion mas economica en general, a 80 a 90% por debajo del precio de marca. Skyrizi es consistentemente el mas caro de los tres porque no tiene precio negociado por Medicare ni competencia generica o biosimilar en 2026.
